summary: Iteration 55: Payment Gateway Module Testing Complete. All 11 backend API tests passed. Frontend verification confirmed: 1) PG Integrator Filter working (shows only PG Universal/PG No universal integrators + 'Sin integrador por el momento'), 2) Many-to-many validation allows same concept on different banks, 3) PDF generation for GATEWAY quotes works with pg_setup_items, 4) VPOS flow unchanged.

details: When quote_type='GATEWAY', integrator dropdown filters by integration_modality IN ('PG Universal', 'PG No universal')
'Sin integrador por el momento' option added at bottom for PG quotes
Changed filter from existingConceptos (all) to existingForBank (per-bank)
Same concept can now be added for different banks (e.g., Débito for Banco A AND Débito for Banco B)
Same concept + same bank combination is still blocked
PDF generated with pg_setup_items (4 pages: Portada, Matriz de Configuración, Costos Recurrentes, Términos)
generate() method dispatches to generate_pg() when quote_type=='GATEWAY'
generate_vpos() method unaffected by PG changes
POST /api/quotes/create-with-pdf stores pg_setup_items in quote document
Many-to-many items (same concept, different banks) stored correctly
'Descargar PDF' option available in quote actions menu for GATEWAY quotes
PDF download triggers correctly from the UI
